data.one_liner: A 2.5D page flip engine with physics-based paper fold, shadows, sound and haptic feedback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance page-flip engine for Flutter supporting single-page views and two-page spreads. It features physics-based paper curling, shadows, audio effects, haptics, and accessibility support across all 6 Flutter platforms.
use_when: Building an ebook reader, magazine app, or book-like interface in Flutter
You need realistic physics-based page turns with haptic feedback and sound
avoid_when: You require complex full 3D mesh simulations rather than a 2.5D page turn approximation
You only need standard linear scrolling or slide transitions
strengths: Extensively tested with over 1,500 tests and zero analyzer issues
Supports all six Flutter platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Includes intelligent memory windowing to maintain a constant memory footprint regardless of book length
weaknesses: Desktop platforms lack built-in default sound, requiring a custom sound player implementation
Renders as a 2.5D approximation (path clipping plus textured mesh) rather than a true 3D paper simulation
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.44 or newer. Audio and haptic features work out of the box on mobile and web, but desktop requires providing a custom PageFlipSoundPlayer.
